scope: JANUS Cousteau / Bay of Bengal marine anomaly hunt

target.area: continental slope off Pudimadaka-Godavari, Andhra Pradesh, India

observation_or_claim: GSI/NGDR formally reviewed the request for cruise-specific SM-222 multibeam bathymetry and stated that the requested MBES data/product cannot be shared under the prevailing DST bathymetric data-sharing policy because the requested cruise-specific product contains values below the prescribed sharing thresholds.
source_or_dataset: Official NGDR Helpdesk / Geological Survey of India response after referral to the concerned GSI team
source_url_or_identifier: DST F. No. SM/25/02/2020 (Part-I), dated 15 February 2021

policy_thresholds_as_stated_by_gsi.interpretation_limit: Record only what GSI stated. Do not infer a native grid resolution, classification level, or exact withheld cell size from the threshold statement.

scientific_effect.meaning: The lack of an SM-222 grid is no longer a mere retrieval failure or unresolved referral. It is an explicit policy-based access denial for the requested cruise-specific MBES product. The morphology test at the target remains unresolved.

alternative_explanations: A policy-compliant degraded or generalized bathymetric product may exist even though the requested cruise-specific MBES product cannot be shared.
A different public GSI/NGDR product, report figure, contour surface, or derived grid may cover the same coordinate within the permitted sharing thresholds.
Independent public bathymetry from another institution may provide a weaker but still useful morphology test.

falsifier_or_killer_test.primary: Obtain a policy-compliant bathymetric product covering 17.0710306 N, 83.2693611 E at the permitted GSI/DST sharing level and test the local morphology without requesting restricted native-resolution MBES.
requested_product_classes: degraded or generalized grid compliant with the stated 10 m / 100 m thresholds
publicly releasable contour or raster product
NGDR/GSI dataset identifier or authenticated/public download route
other policy-compliant bathymetric derivative covering the coordinate

next_action.action: Reply once in the existing GSI/NGDR thread asking whether a degraded/generalized or otherwise policy-compliant bathymetric product exists for the same area and coordinate.

promotion_constraints: POLICY_BLOCKED is an access result, not a scientific detection.
Do not convert refusal to share data into evidence for an anomaly, artificial structure, impact, concealment, or any other physical interpretation.
Cruise/project coverage does not prove valid MBES swath coverage at the exact target unless a released product or authoritative footprint establishes it.
A lower-resolution or generalized product may be sufficient for a coarse morphology test but must not be represented as equivalent to native-resolution MBES.
Preserve the distinction between unavailable data, policy-restricted data, and negative scientific evidence.
anti_loop_rule: Do not repeat requests for restricted native-resolution SM-222 MBES unless GSI changes the applicable policy or explicitly invites a new route. Future retrieval should target only policy-compliant degraded/public products or independent lawful datasets.
